en: Pick any of your squishies and test how squishy it is. No coins, no timer: just squish!
Hand: grab the edge to stretch it (two fingers stretch both ways), grab the middle to pick it up and throw it, tap to poke a dent.
Press, Roller and Squeeze: hold or drag to flatten it. Ball: tap to drop a heavy rubber ball. Drop: lift it high and let go. New tools open as the Lab grows.
Foam squishies rise back slowly, jelly ones wobble, rubber ones bounce. Squishies never break, they always spring back.
No coins here: it's just for fun. Every squish past 50% on the squish-o-meter helps the Lab grow.
